en-US: Who do you think will be elected (president or mayor)?
What party do you belong to?

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: I tùi góa ê chheh the̍h-khì. I the̍h góa ê chheh khì.
Tùi chit ê ji̍h-lo̍h-khì, chiū ē to̍h. (a switch, a lighter) Ji̍h chit ê lo̍h-khì, chiū ē to̍h.
zh-Hant-TW: 把這個擦下去就會點上
en-US: Press this down and it will light.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Chi̍t ē tùi hit téng âng bō-á liù-khí-lâi khòaⁿ - (L. 32) Chi̍t ē liù hit téng âng bō-á khí-lâi khòaⁿ…
zh-Hant-TW: 一把那頂紅帽子脫起來看
en-US: As soos as they lifed the red hat and took a look….

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Tùi kha-tòng ta̍h-lo̍h-khì, chhia chiū ē tòng-tiām. Ta̍h kha-tòng lo̍h-khì, chhia chiū ē tòng-tiām.
zh-Hant-TW: 把腳剎車機踩下去，車子就會停止
en-US: Push down the foot brake and the car (or any vehicle) will stop.
The opposite of the heaven is hell.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Lí nā án-ni kóng chiū bô-tùi.
en-US: If you say that, you are wrong.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Chhiáⁿ lí tùi khòaⁿ ū m̄-tio̍h bô?
en-US: Please check it over and see if there are any mistakes.
I beg your pardon | excuse me

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Góa siuⁿ bān lâi, chin tùi-put-chū.
en-US: I came too late, excuse me.

zh-Hant-TW: 正好 | 剛剛 | 剛才

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Chit phìⁿ piah giōng-giōng boeh tó-lo̍h-lâi, ài giâ chi̍t ki thiāu-á tú-lè.
zh-Hant-TW: 這牆壁幾乎要塌下來，拿一根柱子來支住
en-US: This wall is just about ready to tumble down, it must be supported with a pole.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Lí nā tú-tio̍h Sîn-hū, chhiáⁿ lí thè góa kā i chhéng-an.
zh-Hant-TW: 如果你遇到神父，請你代我向他請安
en-US: If you meet Father, will you please greet him for me? (remember me to him)

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Góa tú-tú boeh khì lín chhù, lí tú-tú lâi, chin tú hó.
zh-Hant-TW: 我剛剛要去你家，你剛好來，真湊巧
en-US: I was just going to your house, and you just came, this is just right.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Bîn-ná-chài boeh chhut-phâng ê hòe-bu̍t-chûn ū chi̍t bān tùn.
zh-Hant-TW: 明天將要起航的貨船有一萬頓
en-US: The cargo boat, which will sail tomorrow has a capacity of 10,000 tons.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Chit tun (tui) keng-chio bē lí gō͘ kho͘ tio̍h hó.
zh-Hant-TW: 這堆香蕉賣給你五元就好
en-US: I’ll sell you this pile of bananas for five dollars.
have | has | there is | there are

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: I kóng ê khah ū iáⁿ; lí kóng ê khah bô iáⁿ.
zh-Hant-TW: 他講的比較真實，你講得比較不真實
en-US: There is more truth to what he says; there is less truth to what you say.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: ū miâ bô si̍t | iú bêng bû-si̍t
nan-TW-Latn-tailo: ū miâ bô si̍t | iú bîng bû-si̍t
en-US: having a name | but no realiry.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: ū ê só͘-chai ê lâng sī án-ni kóng.
zh-Hant-TW: 有的地方的人是這麼講
en-US: People in some places talk that way.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Thian-chú í-gōa, sím-mih lâng ē-tàng chō chiah-ni̍h tōa ê ú-tiū.
zh-Hant-TW: 天主之外，什麼人能夠造出這麼大的宇宙
en-US: Who, but God, could make such a great universe!
to apply ice to a wound

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Jia̍t chin koân, ài ù-peng kap khùn peng-chím chiah hó.
zh-Hant-TW: 熱度很高，必須以冰覆蓋和睡冰枕才好
en-US: The fever is very high, you must apply ice and sleep on an ice pillow.
for the sake of | on account of
Have you ever had a stomach-ache?

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Ēng chǹg-á ui chi̍t khang, thang chhng soh-á.
zh-Hant-TW: 用鑽子穿一個洞，以便穿繩子
en-US: Bore a hole with a drill so that a cord can be put through.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Bó͘-bó͘ lâng chin ū ui-giâm, ta̍k-ê kàu-iú lóng chin kiaⁿ i.
zh-Hant-TW: 某某人很有威嚴，每個教友都很怕他
en-US: So-and-so is very dignified, all the Christians revere him.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Góa chit hāng tāi-chì úi-jīm lu̍t-su teh pān-lí.
zh-Hant-TW: 我這件事情委任律師在辦理
en-US: I entrusted this matter to a lawyer to take care of.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Hit ê hoān-lâng lí tio̍h-ài siông-siông kā an-ùi.
zh-Hant-TW: 那個犯人你要常常安慰他
en-US: You should frequently go and console that prisoner.
to be sick of (food) | to dread | to fear | to be disgudted with

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Ta̍k-ji̍t chia̍h chhe-chhau (or chheⁿ-chhau), só͘-í chím-má khòaⁿ-tio̍h bah chiū ē ùi.
zh-Hant-TW: 每天吃盛餐所以現在看到肉就會厭倦
en-US: We have a baquet every day, so now when I see meat, I become disgusted.
feel a chill (shivery) | have a cold fit

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Chím-má teh ùi-kôaⁿ, tāi-khài ū jia̍t.
zh-Hant-TW: 正感惡寒戰慄恐怕有熱度
en-US: I am now shivering, I most probably have a fever.
to enclose | fence off | rope off

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Chit ê hî-tî-á bô ûi-khí-lâi bē ēng-tit bē ēng-tit, àm-sî lâng tiāⁿ-tiāⁿ lâi thau lia̍h hî.
zh-Hant-TW: 這個魚池非圍起來不可，晚上常有他人來偷魚
en-US: If this fish pond is not fenced off, it just won’t do, there are always people coming at night to steal the fish.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Tú-chiah boah âng-mô͘-thô͘ ê só͘-chai, ài ēng soh-á ûi-khí-lâi, khah bē hō͘ lâng ta̍h-tio̍h.
zh-Hant-TW: 剛才塗上水泥的地方須用繩子圍起來，才不致被人踩上
en-US: A place where concrete has just been laid, should be roped off, then it will not so easily be tramped on by people.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Lāu-su bô lâi, gín-ná ún-tàng chhit-thô.
zh-Hant-TW: 老師沒來，孩子們定在遊玩
en-US: The teacher did not come, the children can play very safely (freely).

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Lí chia̍h thō͘-ma-tò͘ ài ùn thn̂g bô?
en-US: Do you dip your tomatoes in sugar when you eat them?

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Góa chin pháiⁿ ūn, phàng-kìⁿ chi̍t pah kho͘.
zh-Hant-TW: 我的運氣很壞，丟掉了一百元
en-US: I have had some very bad luck; I lost a hundred dollars.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: I tùi ūn-tōng chin ū chhù-bī.
en-US: He is very much interested in sports.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Chiah ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ boeh ūn-poaⁿ khì Tâi-pak, ūn-kim ài lōa chē?
zh-Hant-TW: 這些東西搬運到台北，運輸費要多少
en-US: What would be the cost of transportation to transport these things to Taipei?
to put in motion (a car, machine) | to drive

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Khì-chhia lí ē hiáu ūn-choán bē?
en-US: Do you know how to drive a car?

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Chhiáⁿ lí ûn-ná-sī, m̄-bián siuⁿ kóaⁿ-kín.
en-US: Take your time, no need of such a rush.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Chhiáⁿ lí ûn-ûn-ná chia̍h, chia̍h hō͘ pá
en-US: Take your time eating, and stuff yourself.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Tùi sī-tōa tio̍h-ài khah un-sûn lè!
en-US: You should be more meek towards your superiors.

nan-TW-Latn-pehoeji: Chiong-hòa ê Pat-kòa soaⁿ ū un-chôaⁿ.
zh-Hant-TW: 彰化的八卦山上有溫泉
en-US: There are hot springs in Changhua on Pat Koa Mountain.
